title: 2 GitHub Projects Turn Coding Into Art #github
description:
Every now and then, GitHub drops projects that don’t just solve problems — they spark joy.
Today, I’ll introduce two GitHub tools that have recently gained serious attention.
One turns your commit history into a cinematic story you can actually share…

https://github.com/vishkx/gitstory

And the other? It literally turns your terminal into a cozy Christmas fireplace.

https://github.com/leereilly/gh-yule-log

#github #opensource
